hits.text: Viktor Frankl, the Austrian psychiatrist and Holocaust survivor, wrote extensively about meaning. Between stimulus and response there is a space. In that space is our freedom and our power to choose our response. In our response lies our growth and our freedom. This insight came from his years in concentration camps.
